title: Beyond Code Generation: Reliability, Verification, and Cost Economics in the Agentic Software Development Lifecycle
abstract: arXiv:2609.04681v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI coding systems are moving from autocomplete and chat toward agents that can inspect repositories, edit multiple files, run tools, write tests, open pull requests, and work for long periods with limited supervision. This capability changes the bottleneck in software delivery. Recent field studies show meaningful gains in coding activity, but newer evidence also shows that those gains attenuate sharply between writing code and shipping reliable software. Review, integration, testing, security, deployment, and production operations remain constraining stages, while the economics are shifting from predictable per-seat licensing toward variable token, tool, sandbox, CI, and rework costs.   This paper synthesizes peer-reviewed software-engineering research, university studies, benchmark audits, production reports from major technology companies, developer telemetry, and cost-management evidence released primarily from 2024 through Septemb

translated_title: 超越代码生成：智能体软件开发生命周期中的可靠性、验证与成本经济学
translated_abstract: AI 编程系统正从自动补全和对话式助手演进为能够检查代码仓库、编辑多个文件、运行工具、编写测试、发起拉取请求，并在有限监督下长时间自主工作的智能体。这种能力改变了软件交付的瓶颈所在。近期的实地研究显示编码活动获得了显著收益，但更新的证据也表明，这些收益在从编写代码到交付可靠软件的过程中会急剧衰减。代码审查、集成、测试、安全、部署和生产运维仍是制约性环节，而成本结构也正从可预测的按席位授权模式转向可变的 token、工具、沙箱、持续集成（CI）以及返工成本。本文综合了同行评审的软件工程研究、大学研究、基准测试审计、来自主要科技公司的生产报告、开发者遥测数据以及主要发布于 2024 年至 9 月期间的成本管理证据。
tldr: 该论文系统综述了 AI 编程智能体在软件开发中的证据，指出其生产力收益在从编码到交付可靠软件的环节急剧衰减，瓶颈已转移至审查、测试、部署等阶段，且成本模式正从按席位授权转向基于用量的可变成本。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically synthesizes evidence that AI coding agents' productivity gains attenuate sharply between writing code and shipping reliable software, with bottlenecks shifting to review, verification, and deployment stages while economics evolve from per-seat licensing toward variable usage-based costs.
